items.title: Intro to Kiro (One agent, every surface) | Kiro: Zero to Hero 01
items.summary: An introduction for developers who are new to Kiro. Kiro lets you use the same agent from the IDE, the CLI, Kiro Web, and the Kiro mobile app. Web needs a paid plan, and the iOS app is in early access. Using a meeting-room booking app as the running example, with real screenshots and diagrams, this deck walks you through installing Kiro and making your first request. It then covers how to ask and which built-in agent to pick, Autopilot and Supervised modes, approving commands, reviewing diffs and undoing changes, and how models and credits work. Two short examples give a first look at steering, hooks, specs, and MCP, which later decks in the series cover in depth. As of November 2026 (Kiro IDE 1.4, Kiro CLI 3.1). This is deck 01, in the Get started part of the Kiro: Zero to Hero series.
